name: Ryuukan Ameri
source:
Creative Point: Fashion Model
Special Skill: Makeup, Taking and Editing Pictures
Favorite Food: Potato Salad
Hobby: Photo-based Social Media

A popular model in fashion magazines. She's often featured on magazine covers, and recently was invited to a fashion show.
She was at the top of the school pecking order, but recently she's been too busy to meet with her friends.
A savvy and experienced social media user, she doesn't seem to complement [url=https://vndb.org/c87836]Tomohiro[/url] at all. Yet for some reason, she's been hanging out with the student council lately.

"Uhmmm, I do like crowds, you know? Also, festival!
It's the very definition of 'enjoying your summer.'"

[From the [url=https://madosoft.net/hamidashi_totsu/character]official website[/url]]
